about.heading: A neighborhood florist since 1998
paragraphs: Maria and Luis Ortega opened Sunrise Florist on Lake Avenue in 1998. Their daughter Ana runs the shop today, and most arrangements are still made by family.
Flowers come from the Los Angeles Flower Market three mornings a week, so what you see in the cooler changes with the season.
Same-day delivery is available across Pasadena, Altadena, and South Pasadena for orders placed before noon.
